extra.message: The X-Requester-Email request header (requesterEmail) is concatenated directly into a SQL string passed to Statement.executeQuery: "... WHERE u.email = '" + requesterEmail + "' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC". This allows SQL injection.

cwe: CWE-89: SQL Injection

extra.message: The X-Legacy-Batch header is base64-decoded and passed to ObjectInputStream.readObject(), deserializing attacker-controlled data with no class filtering. A crafted serialized gadget can achieve remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: The caller-supplied retUrl from CreateTicketRequest is placed directly into the Location header of a 303 response without validation, allowing an open redirect to an arbitrary external site.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: Phone-channel credentials are hashed with unsalted MD5 (MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5")) for both storage and verification. MD5 is fast and broken, enabling brute-force of stored credential hashes.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

extra.message: The user-supplied 'target' value is concatenated into a shell command ("soffice --headless --convert-to " + target + ...) that is executed via ProcessBuilder("sh", "-c", command). An attacker can inject shell metacharacters (e.g. '; rm -rf', backticks, $()) to run arbitrary OS commands.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: storeArchiveDocument resolves the caller-supplied documentName directly against baseDirectory (baseDirectory.resolve(documentName)) with no normalization or containment check, then writes the submitted bytes there. A name such as '../../../../etc/cron.d/x' escapes the store and allows arbitrary file write.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: archiveIndex resolves the caller-supplied folder against baseDirectory without a containment check and lists its contents with Files.list. An attacker can enumerate arbitrary filesystem directories (e.g. '../../..').

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: A DocumentBuilderFactory is created with default settings (no FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING, no disallow-doctype-decl, no external-entity disabling) and parses the uploaded XML document, enabling XML External Entity (XXE) attacks for file disclosure and SSRF.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: The admin-supplied feedUrl is passed directly to restTemplate.getForObject() with no allow-list or private-address restriction, allowing server-side request forgery against internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: retainSubmitted resolves the raw client-supplied multipart filename (file.getOriginalFilename()) directly against the imports folder and calls transferTo, so a filename such as '../../../../tmp/evil' writes outside the intended directory (arbitrary file write).

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: archiveReport resolves the caller-controlled folder (taken from the SD_REPORT_DIR cookie) against the storage base with no containment check and writes the report file there, allowing path traversal write outside the reports directory.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: The expr request parameter is evaluated as a Spring Expression Language expression (parser.parseExpression(expr).getValue(context)) on a StandardEvaluationContext. SpEL permits type references and bean/method invocation (e.g. T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec(...)), giving remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-917: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an Expression Language Statement ('Expression Language Injection')

extra.message: updProfile copies all non-null properties from the request-bound ProfileDetails object onto the authenticated user's own AppUser via BeanUtils.copyProperties. ProfileDetails exposes 'role' and 'enabled' setters, so any user can POST /profile?role=SUPPORT_ADMIN and escalate to administrator (privilege escalation via mass assignment).

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: findByEmployeeNumber builds an LDAP search filter by concatenating the caller-supplied employeeNumber ((employeeNumber=<input>)) with no escaping, allowing LDAP injection to alter the search filter and enumerate directory entries.

cwe: CWE-90: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

extra.message: findByUid concatenates the caller-supplied uid into the LDAP filter ((&(objectClass=person)(uid=<input>))) without escaping, allowing LDAP injection and directory enumeration or filter bypass.

cwe: CWE-90: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

extra.message: searchAgents builds an XPath expression ("//agent[name='" + name + "']") from the request-supplied name and evaluates it via document.selectNodes. A value such as ']|//*|//agent[name=' allows XPath injection to return arbitrary nodes.

cwe: CWE-643: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')

extra.message: The partner status feed is unauthenticated and the receipt is only parsed with SignedJWT.parse(); the JWT signature is never verified (no verify/JWSVerifier call). An attacker can forge a token whose 'organization' claim names any organization and read that organization's tickets.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: conversationReceipt is annotated @PreAuthorize("permitAll()") (and /portal/conversations/** is permitAll in SecurityConfig), yet it returns the public conversation for any ticketId found under a sequential, guessable reference (CH-4128, CH-4129, ...). An unauthenticated attacker can enumerate references to read other organizations' ticket conversations (IDOR).

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: The queue-search endpoint is annotated @CrossOrigin(originPatterns = "*", allowCredentials = "true"), reflecting any Origin and permitting credentialed requests. Any website can make a logged-in agent's browser fetch their ticket data cross-origin and read the response.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: CSRF protection is explicitly disabled for the state-changing endpoint /desk/tickets/bulk-state (csrf.ignoringRequestMatchers), so the session-authenticated bulk status change can be triggered cross-site without a CSRF token.

cwe: CWE-352: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)

extra.message: The attachment's originalFilename is rendered with th:utext (unescaped HTML). AttachmentService.sanitiseDisplayName only strips control characters, quotes, backslash and slash, leaving '<', '>' and '&' intact, so a file named '.txt' produces stored XSS when an agent views the ticket's attachments.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: The SD_DESK_SESSION cookie is created containing the raw session id (request.getSession().getId()) with setHttpOnly(false) and setSecure(false), exposing the session identifier to client-side scripts and to plaintext transport, enabling session hijacking.

cwe: CWE-1004: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag

extra.message: On a rejected integration credential the full presented API key is written to the application log (log.warn("... presented={} ...", presented, ...)), exposing live secret material to anyone with log access.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: setWebhookTarget updates the target URL without calling validateWebhookTarget (unlike createWebhook at line 174), so an operator can retarget a webhook at loopback/link-local/internal addresses. WebhookService then POSTs to that URL in deliverPending, yielding SSRF.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: AES/CBC is used with a constant all-zero IV (new IvParameterSpec(new byte[16])) and a hard-coded default key ('AcmeSupportDesk!'). A static IV with a fixed key makes ciphertexts deterministic and malleable, undermining the confidentiality goal of the share link token.

cwe: CWE-329: Generation of Predictable IV with CBC Mode

extra.message: server.error.include-stacktrace: always and include-message: always (with root DEBUG logging) return internal exception stack traces and messages to clients, disclosing implementation details and potentially sensitive data.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: Hard-coded default secrets are embedded in configuration: demo-password Passw0rd!23, links cipher-key AcmeSupportDesk!, partner directory-credential pd_live_acme_bridge_0001 and assist access-key asst_live_acme_triage_0001. These are used whenever the environment variables are unset.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: A Tomcat DefaultServlet is mapped to /archive/* with listings=true and the Tomcat document root set to the attachment store, exposing a browsable directory listing of every stored attachment file to any authenticated user.

cwe: CWE-548: Exposure of Information Through Directory Listing

extra.message: loadCoverage reads an arbitrary email from an uploaded file, looks up any account (no authorization check that the caller may cover that person), and stores its id in the session as SD_ACTING_USER. coverageQueue then builds a CurrentUser for that account and runs searchForStaff, letting any agent assume another user's team scope and read out-of-scope tickets.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization
